body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes empty i18n translations across MSW/mock mode, console server mode (`pnpm start`), and root dev mode (`pnpm dev`) by aligning the i18n service contract with the spec, ensuring `AppPlugin` is registered and has an i18n service available during init/start, and providing a spec-format `translations` array for `AppPlugin.loadTranslations()`.

**Changes:**
- Add spec-format `translations` arrays (and defaultLocale) to configs so `AppPlugin.loadTranslations()` can populate the i18n service in server mode.
- Register an in-memory i18n service early (init phase) via `MemoryI18nPlugin`, and explicitly include `AppPlugin` in host configs.
- Fix MSW/mock i18n service `getTranslations()` to return a flat translations dict and add regression tests for the full pipeline.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| objectstack.config.ts | Aggregates i18n bundles across example stacks; builds spec-format `translations`; registers memory i18n service early for root dev server. |
| apps/console/objectstack.config.ts | Adds init-phase memory i18n service registration and explicitly registers `AppPlugin(sharedConfig)` in host config. |
| apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts | Builds and exports spec-format `translations` array + `defaultLocale` for server-mode `AppPlugin.loadTranslations()`. |
| apps/console/src/mocks/createKernel.ts | Fixes i18n service return shape to match spec; expands mock i18n service surface area for dispatcher/AppPlugin compatibility. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/i18n-translations.test.ts | Adds regression tests covering kernel/dispatcher/MSW/server-mode loading flow. |
| CHANGELOG.md | Documents the i18n fixes and their root causes. |
</details>

`defaultLocale` is hard-coded to `'en'` in the mock i18n service, even though the app config now carries `i18n.defaultLocale`. This can make MSW/mock behavior diverge from server mode when a stack sets a different default locale. Initialize `defaultLocale` from `appConfig.i18n?.defaultLocale` (with a fallback) and consider using that value in `setDefaultLocale`/`getDefaultLocale` consistently.
```suggestion
    let defaultLocale = appConfig.i18n?.defaultLocale ?? 'en';
```

`createMemoryI18n` is resolved differently from the other plugin constructors: it does not fall back to the module's default export (e.g. when the default export is the function itself) and is called without validating it was found. If the `@objectstack/core` export shape differs in a given build, this will fail at runtime with `createMemoryI18n is not a function`. Make the resolution consistent with the others (include a `(CorePkg as any).default` fallback) and throw a clear error if it still can't be resolved before calling it.
